name: Alpenrose Hotel Garni
beschreibung: The Alpenrose Hotel Garni in Gerlos is located in Tyrol's Zillertal Valley. The property offers comfortable rooms with private bathrooms and, in some cases, balconies. A generous buffet breakfast is served each morning. A sauna area and free Wi-Fi are also available. The hotel is particularly popular with active vacationers exploring the surrounding hiking trails and the Zillertal Arena. Guests enjoy a quiet village setting with convenient access to the region's infrastructure.
